import parse

# Test current behavior with left alignment
result = parse.parse('{:<}', 'hello world')
print('Left align:', result)

result = parse.parse('{:^}', 'hello world')
print('Center align:', result)

result = parse.parse('{:>}', 'hello world')
print('Right align:', result)

# More tests
result = parse.parse('{:<} world', 'hello world')
print('Left align with suffix:', result)

result = parse.parse('{:^} world', 'hello world')
print('Center align with suffix:', result)
"
